question: The income of A is 70% more than the income of B, and the income of C is 80% of the combined income of A and B. By what percentage is the income of A less than that of C? (Correct to one decimal place)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume income of B = 100 ⇒ Income of A = 170.

Income of C = 80% of (170 + 100) = 0.8 × 270 = 216.

Difference between C and A = 216 − 170 = 46.

Required % difference = (46 ÷ 216) × 100 = 21.29% ≈ 21.3%.

**∴ The correct answer is 21.3%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Income of A is 70% more than B.

Income of C is 80% of the combined income of A and B.
